name: Transport US, LLC - RV storage lot
source: Measured from Google Maps satellite imagery (zoom 19, 0.335 m/px mosaic) and Street View, Nov 2026
accuracy_note: Lot edge, pavement and rows were measured from the imagery by colour segmentation and line fitting; expect about +/- 1-1.5 m plus any offset in Google's own georeferencing. Building heights are estimated from Street View. The lot has no painted stalls: this is a proposed organized layout. Row centre-lines are the lines fitted to the units parked in the zoom-20 imagery, extended the full length of the lot at a uniform 4.0 m spacing and 40 degree angle, with cross aisles left open. occupied_in_imagery marks stalls that had a unit within 2.6 m in the photo.
glb_frame: X = east, Y = up, Z = -north; node names match ids here (slot_A-01, zone_Z-NORTH, bldg_office, ...)
